chapter: Brass bands, Eddie Miller and band stories
title: How Brownlee started on cornet; end of first tape
summary: He picked up cornet with no teacher and reads, in his words, by spelling; the tape runs out.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: It all ties in, I think. How did you get started on Cornette?

I just picked it up playing around. No particular reason. I used to go up there and play with him a little bit. Try it anyway. In those days I had my original teeth. Did you have a teacher? No, no I don't teach.
Did you ever have a teacher?
Just taught yourself how to read and everything.
Well not that I read so good. Let's say I don't read, I spell. Yeah.
The tape is just about over. Let me let it run off before we get into something else. Bye.
